pattern: (either|at least one of)\W+`click_id`\W+or\W+`customer_key`|outside test mode, provide at least one of|pass `customer_key` or `click_id` to identify|or the `customer_key` set at signup
why: Lead rule: send the click_id on every lead. A first lead with only customer_key answers 400 Customer not found, because the key is saved on the customer only when a lead settles. The sale rule (`customer_key` or `click_id`) is unchanged and not matched.

pattern: at least one of `customerExternalId` or `clickId` is required(?!, and `amount`)|optional but improves binding
why: trackLead: the SDK throws only when both are missing; a first lead without clickId returns ok: false, status 400. The trackSale sentence ("is required, and `amount` ...") is still true and not matched.

pattern: proportionally
why: Refunds: a partial refund reduces a commission already approved and cancels one still pending whole. Say which, not "reduced proportionally".

pattern: proper recurring commission attribution
why: subscription_id is only stored with the sale; it plays no part in finding the customer or in the commission.

pattern: need both locations|in \*\*(both\*\* places|two places\*\*)|both `metadata` and `subscription_data\.metadata`
why: Subscriptions need subscription_data.metadata: their payments are read from invoices, which carry the subscription's metadata, not the session's. The session metadata is not also required.

pattern: onboard verify
why: affitor onboard has no verify subcommand; `npx affitor onboard` itself fires the synthetic chain.

pattern: required metadata on every checkout
why: Not every checkout field is required: program_id is Recommended and affitor_click_id may be empty on repeat purchases.

pattern: reversed by this call
why: deductionAmount is the commission share a refund covers. For a pending commission it is informational (the commission is cancelled whole) and nothing leaves the partner's balance.

pattern: arrives with no partner attribution
why: Without the click id, a first trackLead answers 400 Customer not found and no lead is recorded.

pattern: will double-count
why: A renewal sent with trackSale while Stripe is connected is refused as a duplicate (same invoice id); the real risk is that a Stripe refund does not reverse its commission.

pattern: record (is )?created (at|when the) signup|affitor\??\.signup\(\s*\{
why: The customer record is created at the partner click; signup saves your customer_key on it when the lead settles. The browser helper is signup(customerKey, email), not an object.

pattern: months of (payments|renewals)|months after signup
why: Recurring earns until the months in For have passed since the customer's first click on the partner link, not for N payments or N months after signup; later payments get a $0 commission.

pattern: no customer record exists|accept that the lead will be unattributed|lead is still recorded \(unattributed\)|unattributed unless you pass `customer_key`
why: The customer is created at the click; a lead without a click answers 400 and records nothing, and customer_key alone cannot recover attribution (it is saved only when a lead settles).

pattern: unless you approve, reject,? or extend the hold
why: Extending the hold only moves the approval date; the commission still auto-approves when the extended hold ends. Test and own-team commissions are never auto-approved; $0 commissions after the commission term are not auto-approved while they stay at $0.

pattern: fee may apply depending on the (payout )?method
why: The withdrawal processing fee is one setting for every withdrawal (a percentage or a fixed amount), not per payout method.

pattern: adds the `trackSale` call whether or not|`npx affitor onboard` adds one to a
why: CLI 0.4.5 reads stripe_account_bound for a certain runtime key. A true binding skips injection; unknown/false or uncertain env keeps unattended webhook unchanged. Existing calls are not removed.

pattern: not taken back automatically
why: Since CMS v3.16.139 a new invoice paid by several charges, or by a payment shared with other invoices, is not recorded as a sale, and a new invoice refunded before processing is not recorded; older such sales are held for manual reconciliation.

pattern: refund answers `Invalid API token`
why: An empty Bearer token on POST /api/v1/track/refund answers 401 `Empty Bearer token` (CMS v3.16.140).

pattern: Every click and sale through it is credited to you|Affitor tracks every click and conversion on it|All of them track the same way|Every click and sale through your link is tracked to you|Affitor records every click on it
why: A saved referral link still needs installed landing tracking and the signup/sale integrations; a short redirect is not a tracker or a guarantee that every visit or conversion is attributed. Page-link previews are not saved share URLs.

pattern: first sale's id in `error\.details\.sale_id`|with the recorded sale in `error\.details\.sale_id`|`error\.details\.sale_id` is the recorded sale|A `409` confirms the sale exists|treat as already-recorded, not a retry\)
why: A track/sale 409 returns the earlier sale id only when that sale belongs to the calling program; otherwise error.details.sale_id is null.

pattern: not promised a `409`|handled before the duplicate check|in any tracking request body
why: A test-mode sale with a repeated transaction_id answers 409 duplicate_transaction like a live sale; test_mode applies to click, lead and sale only (refund ignores it).

pattern: quickstart/inviting-partners|invite (your )?partners by (email|CSV)|Invited by a brand\?|CSV invites|pending invites|invites (are|come) pre-written|invitations arrive pre-written|send your first invites
why: Partner invites were archived on 21/10/2026: brands no longer invite partners by email or CSV; partners join through the marketplace or the program page. The old guide redirects to reviewing applications.

pattern: first Affitor invoice with a positive platform fee
why: The current M1 bonus follows the first paid invoice with positive partner commissions, including a zero Affitor fee. Its condition is separate from the unchanged platform-fee-based recurring revenue-share clock.

pattern: refunds? (do|does) not lower|does not lower the revenue
why: Refunds lower program.total_revenue, the $10,000 fee-free counter, by the refunded amount (capped by what the sale added): affiliate-cms commission-refund.ts uncountRevenue, utils/revenue-counter.ts.

pattern: matches each renewal by the buyer's email or
why: Renewal lookup (affiliate-cms webhook-distributor.ts resolveCustomerPartner): click, then email_hash, then stripe_customer_id. The email step only finds a customer whose email Affitor recorded (a settled lead or an earlier attributed payment); say so instead of an unconditional 'email or Stripe customer ID'.

pattern: Accepted but not used yet[;:] commissions are calculated on `amount_cents`
why: For API sales recorded from November 5, 2026 (16:00 UTC), tax_cents is subtracted before pricing the commission basis.

pattern: Attribution does not expire|there is no time-based cut-off on the customer-to-partner relationship
why: First settlement enforces the program attribution window (60 days by default); only already-settled customers skip later window checks.

pattern: TESTCODE
why: A made-up partner code proves nothing: the click endpoint answers 400 for a code that matches no partner link and sets no cookie. Verify with a partner link from your program; new programs print ?via= by default, programs created before 2026-10-16 keep ?aff=, and the tracker reads both.

pattern: \*\*(Generate|Regenerate)\*\*|click Regenerate|workspace owner (regenerates|to regenerate|can (generate|replace))|Settings → API Key\b|Settings\*\* → \*\*API keys
why: API keys v2: owners and admins use Create key or Rotate key under Program settings › Developers › API keys, and the key is shown once in Copy your key. There is no Generate/Regenerate button and no Settings → API Key page. The heading 'Step 3: Regenerate the key' in brand/settings stays for its anchor and is not matched.

pattern: one program per brand connection|brand (picks|connection covers) one program|each connection holds one program|7 brand tools|for its one program
why: MCP connections read the programs chosen at consent: all current and future programs, or up to 50 selected; a brand connection has 8 brand tools (list_programs added), each with an optional program_id. affiliate-cms src/mcp/program-scope.ts, src/mcp/tools/defs.ts MULTI_BRAND_TOOLS.

pattern: transaction_id`? is (still )?consumed
why: A sale is one database transaction: when the commission cannot be created the whole sale rolls back, nothing is recorded and a retry with the same transaction_id is safe. affiliate-cms src/api/affiliate-tracking/services/sale-admission.ts (transaction, CommissionAdmissionFailure), controllers/v1-tracking.ts.

pattern: already stored, so a resend returns `?409|do not cause a 500
why: partnerId required to create commission is answered before the sale is written, and a metric update failure rolls the whole sale back (500, nothing recorded). affiliate-cms src/api/affiliate-tracking/services/sale-admission.ts.

pattern: `USD`, `EUR`,? or `VND`
why: Since November 5, 2026 (16:00 UTC) a sale accepts any supported ISO 4217 code and converts the pre-tax basis to USD; only unsupported codes answer 422. affiliate-cms controllers/v1-tracking.ts, utils/money-basis.ts.

pattern: accepted,? (but )?not used yet
why: tax_cents is subtracted from the commission basis (amount - tax). affiliate-cms utils/money-basis.ts s2sAmounts.

pattern: \(or pass `0`\)|Omit or pass `0`
why: For sales recorded since the November 5, 2026 currency change, an explicit refund amount of 0 answers 400 and nothing is refunded; omit the field to refund the rest. affiliate-cms controllers/v1-tracking.ts (refund_amount_cents presence check).

pattern: Verbose `console\.log` output|for verbose logging|Enable verbose console logs
why: debug: true also makes signup() send a test event instead of a lead, so a site that ships with it records no real leads. affiliate-cms public/js/affitor-tracker.js signup().

pattern: re-run `npx affitor init` to get a new
why: affitor init creates a new program and never replaces an API key; an owner or admin creates or rotates keys in Program settings, Developers, API keys. affitor CLI src/commands/init.ts.

pattern: tick each write permission|is a box you tick
why: The hosted MCP connection is read-only while write access is off: the consent screen shows Read account data, Always on, and no write boxes. Remove this entry in the docs PR that turns write access on.

pattern: \*\*Your agent\*\* › \*\*Connect your AI\*\*|\*\*Your agent\*\*: select \*\*Connect your AI
why: The Tracking step offers With AI and By hand. Connect an AI tool lives in Program settings › Developers › AI agents.

pattern: Lead capture mode
why: The dashboard has no Lead capture mode line. A browser lead that did not settle answers provisional: true.

pattern: \*\*Preferred format\*\*|Choose a format and save
why: Partner link format controls were removed on 2026-10-26; partner links use the query form.

pattern: pick one \*\*Program\*\*|\*\*Access\*\* (is )?always (says )?\*\*Read-only\*\*|Check \*\*Signed in as\*\*
why: The consent screen lets you choose all current and future programs or up to 50, shows your name and email with Switch, and lists Read account data as Always on.

pattern: \*\*Approve all\*\*|\*\*Review each\*\*
why: The new-partner choice is Auto-approve or Manual review.

pattern: \*\*Link to a page\*\*
why: The partner program page has no Link to a page button; a partner makes a page link with Create link on the program's Links tab.

pattern: Inviting a partner
why: Partner invites were archived on 21/10/2026: brands no longer invite partners to a program, so it is not something that could earn.

pattern: (partner|referral) link \(\?aff=CODE\)|detects `\?aff=` and creates|auto-detects `\?aff=PARTNER_CODE` in
why: ?aff= is not the only partner link form: programs created from 16/10/2026 print ?via= unless the brand picks ?aff=, and the tracker reads both.

pattern: respond to all inquiries within 24 hours|Response Commitment|Recruit quality partners in your space|Interested in joining our partner network
why: The contact page made a 24-hour reply promise and partner-recruiting service claims with no source; partners join programs through the marketplace.

pattern: \.env\.example.*(?<!not )(safe[- ]to[- ]commit|template for teammates)|(?<!not a )safe[- ]to[- ]commit template|\.env\.example.*[Ee]nvironment variables template
why: npx affitor init writes the program API key into .affitor/.env.example as well as .affitor/.env, and the .affitor/.env.* rule it adds to .gitignore covers it. It is not a safe-to-commit or shareable template.

pattern: no sale or commission was recorded
why: A 500 from POST /api/v1/track/sale does not prove that nothing was recorded: on the fee-bearing path the server can lose the commit acknowledgement after the sale was saved. Clients retry with the same transaction_id and read a 409 sale_id as recorded.

pattern: transaction_id`? is not consumed
why: After a sale 500 the transaction_id may already hold a recorded sale; a retry with the same id that reaches the duplicate check answers 409 with the sale_id instead of recording again.
